subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace hook discovery emit an operator-visible warning when it skips package.json or HOOK.md over 1 MiB?
rationale: The memory bound is justified, but silently hiding a previously discoverable hook is an upgrade and recovery policy choice that contributor implementation alone cannot settle.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Preserve fail-soft discovery while logging the skipped path and size limit so operators can recover.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Treat oversized metadata like other invalid hook input without an operator-visible diagnostic.

options.title: Fail discovery
options.body: Abort workspace hook discovery when oversized metadata is encountered.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Preserve fail-soft discovery while logging the skipped path and size limit so operators can recover.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and co-authored the current loader and shared-helper introduction and are the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
